## 中文原文

你下班回家，路上顺便去超市买了点水果和牛奶，回到家发现冰箱里还有昨天没吃完的外卖，于是先把新买的东西放进冰箱，然后简单热了点东西当晚饭，吃完后坐在沙发上刷了会儿手机，准备等会儿去洗澡睡觉。

## English translation

I got off work and picked up some fruit and milk on my way home.

When I walked in, I saw there was still some leftover takeout from yesterday in the fridge.

I put away the groceries first, then heated up a quick dinner.

After eating, I lounged on the sofa scrolling through my phone for a bit, before getting ready to shower and head to bed.
